qe: The Ram Mohan Roy Seminary, an important educational institution of the Brahmo Samaj in Bihar, was located in which city?
qh: ब्रह्मो समाज की बिहार में महत्वपूर्ण शिक्षण संस्था राममोहन राय सेमिनरी किस शहर में स्थित थी?
e: Brahmo Samaj ka prachar Bihar me bhi hua tatha iske mandir tatha sansthaen Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur tatha Ranchi jaise jilon me sthapit hui; inme sabse pramukh shiksha-sanstha Patna ki 'Ram Mohan Roy Seminary' thi, jise samaj ke sadasyon ne khada kiya. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar Brahmo Samaj ke pramukh neta Devendra Nath Tagore, Keshav Chandra Sen, Rabindranath Tagore tatha vaigyanik Jagdish Chandra Bose aadi Bihar aaye tatha yahan Brahmo missionaries ne bhi kaam kiya. Brahmo Samaj ne jaati-bhed tatha purdah (parda) ki kathor pratha ka virodh kiya, bal-vivah ka virodh kiya tatha vidhva punarvivah ki wakalat ki; iske prayas se iske anuyayi parivaron me yah sudhar jaldi phaila. Bhagalpur tatha Muzaffarpur me bhi Brahmo Samaj mandir the, lekin Ram Mohan Roy Seminary ka sthal Patna hai - isliye sahi uttar Patna hai. Exam point: Ram Mohan Roy Seminary = Patna (Brahmo Samaj ki shiksha-sanstha); Brahmo Samaj ne jaati-bhed, purdah tatha bal-vivah ka virodh kiya tatha vidhva punarvivah ki wakalat ki; Bihar me iska prabhav Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur tatha Ranchi tak raha.

qe: The Arya Samaj's educational institutions in Bihar, such as the Dayanand Anglo-Vedic College, were set up to promote reform along with which kind of education?
qh: बिहार में आर्य समाज की शिक्षण संस्थाएँ, जैसे दयानंद एंग्लो-वैदिक कॉलेज, सुधार के साथ किस प्रकार की शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने के लिए बनाई गईं?
oe: Education combining Vedic teachings with modern English learning
oh: वैदिक शिक्षा के साथ आधुनिक अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का मेल
e: Arya Samaj ki sthapna Pandit Dayanand Saraswati ne 19vein sadi me Punjab me ki tatha uska uddeshya Vedic granthon ke anusar Hindu samaj ko sudhar kar andhvishwas tatha karmkand ki adhik kriyayein hata dena tha. Isne murti-puja ka virodh kiya tatha hawan-agnihotra ke saath ek ishwar ki puja par zor diya; jaati-vyavastha ko sveekar nahi kiya tatha nichli jatiyon ko apni or aakarshit kiya. Iske sudhar ke pramukh mudde the - bina dahej ke saral vivah, vidhva punarvivah, purdah ki pratha hataana tatha mahilaon ki shiksha. Isi uddeshya se Dayanand Anglo-Vedic (DAV) College tatha school khade kiye gaye, jahan vedic adhyayan ke saath angreji tatha modern vishay bhi padhaye jaate the, taaki vidyarthi dharm-nishth bhi rahein tatha naukri-yogy bhi ban jayein. Isliye sahi uttar 'Vedic shiksha ke saath adhunik angreji shiksha ka mel' hai. Exam point: Arya Samaj ke sansthapak = Swami Dayanand Saraswati; isne bina dahej saral vivah, vidhva punarvivah, purdah-nivaran tatha mahila shiksha par zor diya; DAV College/school Vedic tatha angreji-modern shiksha ka mel karate hain.

qe: The Theosophical Society, which influenced the English-educated intelligentsia of Bihar, was founded in 1875 with its headquarters at which city?
qh: बिहार के अंग्रेजी-शिक्षित वर्ग को प्रभावित करने वाली थियोसोफिकल सोसाइटी की स्थापना 1875 में हुई थी तथा उसका मुख्यालय किस शहर में था?
e: Theosophical Society ki sthapna 1875 me hui tatha uska mukhyalay Banaras (Varanasi) me tha; iske vicharon ka mukhya hissa yah tha ki prachin bharatiya darshan tatha dharm ki baatein tark tatha vigyan ke aadhaar par samjhayi ja sakein. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar is society ki kai shakhayein Bihar me sakriya thi tatha iska asar primarily English-educated varg par pada, kyunki unhe yah sanket bhaaya ki bharatiya dhyan tatha adhyatm ko adhunik bhasha me samjha ja sakta hai. Isi daur me Ramakrishna tatha Vivekananda ke vichar bhi phaile tatha Ramakrishna Mission ne Bihar me baadh tatha akal ke samay relief ka kaam kiya, garib vidyarthiyon ki madad ki tatha muft dawa di. Calcutta, Lahore tatha Bombay bhi samaj-sudhar ke bade kendra the, lekin Theosophical Society ka mukhyalay Banaras me tha - isliye sahi uttar Banaras hai. Exam point: Theosophical Society ki sthapna 1875, mukhyalay Banaras; iska asar Bihar ke English-educated varg par; Ramakrishna Mission ne Bihar me baadh-akal relief, garib chhatron ki sahayata tatha muft chikitsa ka kaam kiya.

qe: In the context of Bihar, the Wahabi movement in India is remembered mainly for which revivalist activity?
qh: बिहार के संदर्भ में भारत में वहाबी आंदोलन मुख्यतः किस पुनरुत्थानवादी गतिविधि के लिए याद किया जाता है?
oe: Collecting funds and recruits for a movement in the north-west frontier region
oh: उत्तर-पश्चिमी सीमांत क्षेत्र के आंदोलन के लिए धन तथा भर्ती जुटाना
महिलाओं में पश्चिमी शिक्षा का प्रसार
e: Wahabi movement ka mukhya uddeshya Islam ko uske prarambhik svaroop me lauta kar purane riwaj tatha sanyukt bhakti-karmon ka virodh karna tatha dharma ki raksha ke liye sangharsh karna tha; isi liye iske samarthak khud ko 'ghair-anukarta' (non-imitators) kehte the. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar is andolan ke pramukh neta Sayyid Ahmad ne lagbhag 1820 me Patna ka daurra kiya tatha us samay se Patna is andolan ka bada kendra ban gaya, jahan se paisa tatha naye sadasya jama karke uttar-pashchim seemant kshetra (North-West Frontier) ke morche par bheje jaate the. Is andolan par sarkar ne sakhti dikhai tatha 1864 me Patna ke wahabiyon par pehla chhaapa pada jisme 11 log giraftar hue; Ahmaddullah (Ahmadullah) ko 27 February 1865 me maut ki saza sunayi gayi, jise High Court ne umar-qaid ke liye badal diya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi me Patna rajnitik tatha dharmik gatividhiyon ka sakriya kendra tha. Isliye sahi uttar 'NW frontier ke liye dhan tatha bharti jutana' hai. Exam point: Wahabi andolan ka Patna kendra 1820 se; Sayyid Ahmad ke daure se yahan paisa tatha bhartiyan jama hokar uttar-pashchim seemant kshetra bheji jaati thi; 1864 me pehla chhaapa, Ahmadullah ko 27 Feb 1865 me maut ki saza, jo umar-qaid me badli.

qe: Which phase of the Wahabi movement in Bihar saw the first police raid on the Patna Wahabis, in which eleven persons were arrested?
qh: बिहार में वहाबी आंदोलन के किस चरण में पटना के वहाबियों पर पहला पुलिस छापा पड़ा, जिसमें ग्यारह व्यक्ति गिरफ्तार हुए?
e: Pustak ke anusar Patna me Wahabi andolan ke samarthakon par pahla chhaapa 1864 me pada, jisme 11 vyakti giraftar kiye gaye; inme Ahmaddullah ke bhai tatha bhatije bhi the, jinhe desh-nikala (transportation) ki saza mili. Ahmaddullah khud us samay shak ke daayre me aaya, lekin saboot kam hone ke karan turant giraftar nahi hua; saal ke ant me use giraftar karke Patna ke judge ke saamne mukadma chalaya gaya tatha 27 February 1865 ko maut ki saza sunayi gayi, jise baad me High Court ne umar-qaid me badal diya. Is daur me Patna me paisa tatha bhartiyan jutane ka kaam 1820 se hi chalta aa raha tha, isliye sarkar ki nazar hamesha is shahar par rahti thi. 1857 ke vidroh ka daur is chhape se alag hai tatha 1875 tatha 1890 ki tareekhein is ghatna se mel nahi khati - isliye sahi uttar 1864 ka chhaapa hai. Exam point: Patna ke Wahabiyon par pehla chhaapa = 1864 (11 giraftar, jisme Ahmaddullah ke bhai tatha bhatije bhi); Ahmaddullah ko 27 February 1865 me maut ki saza, jo High Court ne umar-qaid me badli.

qe: The title 'Muleks' was used in Shahabad (Bihar) for a group of Muslim families known for which practice?
qh: शाहाबाद (बिहार) में 'मुलेक्स' शब्द उन मुस्लिम परिवारों के लिए प्रयुक्त होता था, जो किस बात के लिए जाने जाते थे?
oe: Serving as soldiers in the Mughal army
Reciting poetry describing the love of Radha and Krishna
oh: राधा-कृष्ण के प्रेम का वर्णन करने वाली कविता पढ़ना
e: Pustak ke anusar Shahabad (aaj ke Bhojpur-Rohtas kshetra) ke kuch mushlim parivar 'Muleks' kehlate the tatha woh apna samay Radha-Krishna ke prem ka varnan karne wali kavita (poetry) padhne me bitate the; woh kuch sufi santon ki puja tatha unki dargahon par chadhava bhi karte the. Isse pata chalta hai ki Bihar me Hindu-Muslim sanskriti ka aadan-pradan kitna gambhir tha - ek hi mahaul me Ramayan-Mahabharat ki kathaon ke saath Radha-Krishna ki padavali suni-gaayi jaati thi tatha kabhi Moharram ke juloos me Hindu bhi shamil hote the (jab communalism badha to yah saajhedari kam hui). Aise udaharan pariksha me is baat ko samajhne ke liye kaam aate hain ki lok-sanskriti mazhab ki sakht hadon ko todkar chalti thi. Salt-indigo vyapar, Mughal sena tatha madrasa shikshan alag vishay hain - isliye sahi uttar 'Radha-Krishna prem ki kavita padhna' hai. Exam point: 'Muleks' = Shahabad kshetra ke woh mushlim parivar jo Radha-Krishna ke prem ki kavita padhte tatha sufi santon ki dargah par chadhava chadhate the; yah Hindu-Muslim saanjhi lok-sanskriti ka udaharan hai.

qe: According to 'Bihar Through the Ages', which community was the 'most numerous single community' in Bihar after the Hindus?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' के अनुसार बिहार में हिंदुओं के बाद सबसे अधिक संख्या वाला एकमात्र समुदाय कौन था?
e: Pustak ke anusar Bihar me Hindu samuday ke baad sabse bada ekjatiya samuday mushlim tha; unme samajik roop se do mukhya bhed maane jaate the - 'Ashraf' (jinme Syed, Mughal, Irani, Afghan, Pathan log aate the) tatha 'Ajlaf' (jinhe peshe ke naam par Momins, Kunjra, Jolha, Dhunia, Dhobi, Kalal aadi kaha jaata tha). Zyadatar Ajlaf parivar pehle Hindu the tatha baad me mushlim bane, isliye unme kai Hindu riwaz tatha bimari-va bhut-pret se judi manyataein bani rahi. Shia mushlimon ka sabse bada tyohar Moharram (Hasan-Hussain ki shahadat ka smarak) tha, jisme shuru me Hindu log bhi shaamil hote the; Sunni log Shia se kai guna zyada the. Sikh, Isai tatha Jain samuday bhi Bihar me the, lekin Hindu ke baad sarvadhik jansankhya mushlimon ki thi - isliye sahi uttar Muslims hai. Exam point: Hindu ke baad Bihar ka sabse bada samuday = Mushlim; unke do samajik varg Ashraf (Syed, Mughal, Pathan aadi) tatha Ajlaf (peshe ke naam par Momin, Jolha, Kalal aadi), jinme kai parivaron me Hindu riwaz bache rahe.

qe: The position of women in 19th century Bihar, as described in 'Bihar Through the Ages', was marked chiefly by which practice?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' में वर्णित 19वीं सदी के बिहार में महिलाओं की स्थिति मुख्यतः किस प्रथा से चिह्नित थी?
oe: Purdah and restrictions on public appearance
Free education in schools for all girls
oh: पर्दा तथा सार्वजनिक रूप से बाहर न निकल पाना
सभी बालिकाओं के लिए निःशुल्क विद्यालयी शिक्षा
महिलाओं का ग्राम-मुखिया के रूप में कार्य
e: Pustak ke anusar 19vein sadi ke Bihar me purdah ki pratha kathor thi tatha mahilaon ka sarvajanik roop se bahar nikalna mana maana jaata tha; unhe palanquin tatha parde ke peeche rakha jaata tha tatha aisi stithi me angreji adalat bhi unse commission ke zariye ya judge ke saamne pehredari ke beech bayan leti thi. Purdah dhan tatha rutbe ka chinh ban gaya tha, isliye oonchi khandanon ki mahilayein bhi ise apnati thi tatha unka samajik yogdaan parde ke peeche se hi hota tha. Isi daur me S. C. Bose ne lagbhag 1881 me likha tha ki mahila ka jeevan bachpan se budhape tak udaasi tatha upkeksha se bhara rehta hai. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi ke samaj-sudhar andolan (Brahmo-Arya Samaj aadi) ne mahilaon ki shiksha, purdah-nivaran tatha vidhva punarvivah ko apna mukhya mudda banaya. Compulsory vidhva punarvivah, gram-mukhiya ka pad tatha sabhi balikaon ki muft schooling us samay nahi thi - isliye sahi uttar purdah tatha sarvajanik jeevan se doori hai. Exam point: 19vein sadi ke Bihar me mahilaon ki stithi = kathor purdah tatha sarvajanik jeevan se doori; angreji adalat bhi unka bayan parde ke peeche leti thi; Brahmo tatha Arya Samaj jaise andolanon ne purdah-nivaran, mahila-shiksha tatha vidhva punarvivah par zor diya.
